status: Consolidates acquisition rules and corrections before any new encoder or Bora inference; not a retrospective segmentation performance claim
unit: Distinct native-source ROI image/reference pairs; report patients, slides, cores and ROIs separately
task: Expert or provider-released tissue-region semantic annotations. Exclude nuclei-only, cell-only, gland-instance-only, classification-only and model-prediction-only collections
extra_per_class_minimum: None beyond one usable observation; retain every fine reference class, even absent in coarse supervision
sampling: Use reported/derived exact axes when traceable; target0.5micrometres/px for calibrated sources. Unknown MPP stays unknown with original native pixels. Magnification is not an MPP measurement or an optical-resolution measurement
physical_field: Target up to640micrometres each axis, widened when needed to retain at least896 actual native pixels. Never enlarge a rejected small image to qualify
pixel_only_field: Native ROI up to1280pixels each axis
puma_context: True2048px crop from provider5120px context; require exact central1024px RGBA match to independently released ROI. Only1024px centre carries expert labels; context is ignored in scoring
selection: Acquisition uses annotation-informed boundary/class-diversity windows, no algorithm predictions, accuracy scores or runtime scores. This is a controlled boundary-refinement development benchmark, not population-random sampling
negative_target_tissue_guard: A declared catch-all negative target supplies a tissue group only when >=10% of its central coarse observation is nonwhite H&E. White means minRGB>=230 and channel range<=20. Expert pale-tissue categories are not suppressed
source_spacing: Preserve native axes, working axes, crop coordinates and field of view. No physical-area accuracy claim for uncalibrated sources
geometry: Require source RGB/mask shape agreement or a documented, verified native-grid projection; categorical masks use nearest-neighbour, never average labels
repeated_sources: Select distinct source groups first; additional non-overlapping ROIs can fill a40-field quota, with the exact smaller source/patient count disclosed. No padding, rotated copies, repeated fields or synthetic images
inference: No new Virchow2, conversion, Bora or score run during acquisition
next_benchmark: Freeze a new combined cohort, reconcile shared source cases and sampling, then establish matched parent baselines. Earlier signed cycle scores remain unchanged
